product.intendedPurpose: Encrypted document storage for small accounting practices, deployed on customer premises.
product.securityEnvironment: Runs behind the customer firewall on a hardened Linux host with no direct internet exposure.
product.foreseeableMisuse: Exposing the administration port to the public internet without a reverse proxy.

regulatoryPosition.roleJustification: Develops and markets the product under its own name.
regulatoryPosition.classificationJustification: Not listed in Annex III or Annex IV.

supportPeriod.rationale: Five and a half years from placing on the market, matching the customer contract term and the support period of the runtime.
supportPeriod.publishedAt: https://example.com/vaultkeeper/support and in the purchase confirmation

vulnerabilityHandling.updateDistributionMechanism: Signed npm releases published with build provenance, verified by the installer.

notApplicableRequirements.justification: The product provides no network service to other devices, so it cannot affect the availability of services provided by other devices or networks.

technicalDocumentation.updateProcess: Regenerated and reviewed at every minor release.
